name: pilot-release-bundle-manifest
purpose: Bundle multiple verified development changes into one auditable release candidate before any deployment-provider invocation.

rules.verified_only: Every included change must have a PASSED provider-independent verification result.
rules.single_promotion: The completed bundle is promoted as one release candidate rather than deploying each development change independently.
rules.no_deployment: Creating, updating, or validating the bundle must not invoke the deployment adapter.
rules.traceability: Each bundled change remains individually attributable to its source package and revision.
rules.failure: Any required failed or blocked verification keeps the bundle BLOCKED.
